text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after training,
while walking with North Flight...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
it looks like it's over there!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Whoa, what an attractive lineup♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I need to thank her
for giving me that gift.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apparently, North Flight received this raffle ticket from a classmate the other day as a thank-you for helping coordinate an outfit.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
...When I wore the clothes Flight-chan picked out for me, I felt so calm...
I was able to mingle with the fans without getting stage fright at all!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks a bunch~! You really saved me!
I'd like to thank you properly another time, but...
for now, take this lottery ticket!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you win,
it's all yours, Flight-chan!
Go have fun!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Since I have the chance,
I'm going to aim for the grand prize!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh my♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
we simply have to win it no matter what!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Here I go!
Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight enthusiastically
turned the raffle machine's lever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Wah...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
It's the grand prize.
choice_data_list: That's incredible! It's a hot spring trip!
Isn't that amazing! It's a hot spring trip!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see, a hot spring...!
Amazing, so amazing!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'm actually pretty lucky♪
Yay!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
I got a little too carried away...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! 
I should report back to the girl who gave me the ticket!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, yeah...
Hehe, understood!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll take you up on that offer.
Thanks, see ya!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
When I told her we won the grand prize,
she was super happy, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
She was just stubbornly insisting
that she wanted me to be the one to use it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I suggested that as well, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"It's a token of appreciation for your daily support, so please go with someone you don't have to put on airs around and can just be yourself with."
...apparently.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I feel like
I'm always being my natural self, though.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I guess because I often give all kinds of advice,
people think of me as very caring.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Is that so?
choice_data_list: I want you to smile like you did earlier.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Amaaazing!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'm actually pretty lucky♪
Yay!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She probably wanted North Flight to relax with someone
who could bring out her playful, innocent side to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
“Still... it was in front of you.
That's why...”

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Would it be... wrong of me
to invite you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip.
How about going together?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm always being spoiled
by big sis, after all...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "...Because it seems she can be her true self around you too, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: This time, I... want to lean on you. Of course, only if it's not a bother...
choice_data_list: I'd never think it was a bother.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then...
will you come with me?
choice_data_list: If that's what you wish for.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I want to.
...Yay! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in line with North Flight's wishes...
we decided to align our schedules and go to
a hot spring together someday.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First prize! What wonderful news!
It suits someone like me perfectly, wouldn't you say?♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mmm,
that looks so delicious!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I wonder who I should split this with.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I want to share
my reward with everyone.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Because whether in the development club or in class,
that's how I've always done things!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight seemed genuinely happy to share,
but since she's all on her own right now...
In that case—
choice_data_list: ...Why don't you just keep it all to yourself?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Sizzle, sizzle...—)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Wah, that looks so delicious~...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Is this really all right?
For me to be the only one eating?"
choice_data_list: Come on now, while it's still warm!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Mmm~, sho good~♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The sauce goes wonderfully with the hamburg steak...
The overall balance is perfection!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: It tastes super fancy♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "I'd love for you to try some too, Trainer♪"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll cut it
in half for you.
choice_data_list: ...You know you can have it all to yourself, right?
...You can keep it all to yourself, you know?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That sounds exciting too, but...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm much happier
when I can share wonderful things with others♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I got to have all of
North Flight's kindness entirely to myself.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure I can have
this much?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Carrots are packed with nutrients,
so enjoy them in all kinds of dishes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing.
This one suits me perfectly too, doesn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: All kinds of dishes, huh...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I just had...
a great idea♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Wow, so many side dishes~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's so shiny and glossy, and the plating is gorgeous! Did you make all of this yourself, Flight-san?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I wanted to pack it in a bento box for them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Flight-san, you're such a good cook.
Who are you making that for, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu. She's a hardworking person who's very good at her job♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One morning, North Flight suddenly
showed up at the Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Here, please have some
if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I packed plenty of side dishes, featuring the carrots I won in the lottery the other day as the main star.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's my masterpiece,
so please take a look first!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the lid took my breath away!
Not only was there a mouthwatering array of dishes,
but the colors were so vibrant and beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
When it looks pretty, it gets you excited,
and it makes it taste even better, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I'm confident in the flavor itself.
If you'd like, please have some for lunch today!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
Please don't ask such questions.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"You don't need a reason
to hold someone dear in your heart♪"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Such a vibrant orange color!
That's proof of how fresh and delicious it is.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: A one-of-a-kind gem... Is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm,
it's just perfect for me♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Haha, no doubt about it!
Man, what a positive young lady!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Staying positive is my biggest strength!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still...
I'm not sure how I should eat this... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll give it a quick roast!
It'll make it even more of a masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
So sweet♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
As expected,
professionals in their field are wonderful.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I want to be someone who can bring out the absolute best brilliance in those materials too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear,
a participation prize, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: North Flight, who was always positive, had her shoulders visibly slumped for once.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Tissues are wonderful too, you know?
However...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: "Even though you told me the grand prize suited me so well, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...
I really wanted to pull it off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight was left feeling
utterly disappointed...
